security-audit.description: Run full security audit on x.bin
security-audit.template:
Run a comprehensive security audit on x.bin:
1. Run `cargo audit` for dependency vulnerabilities
2. Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` for lint issues
3. Check for unsafe code violations in xbin-core
4. Verify ANSSI-Rust compliance
5. Report all findings with severity levels

xbin-build.template:
Build x.bin:
1. Run `cargo fmt` to format code
2. Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` to check for issues
3. Run `cargo build --release` with proper environment
4. Verify the build output
5. Report build status and any warnings

xbin-test.template:
Run the complete test suite:
1. Run `cargo test --workspace` for Rust tests
2. Run `cd cli && python -m pytest` for Python tests
3. Report test results with coverage if available
4. Highlight any failing tests and suggest fixes
